packages.reason: Retire the obsolete wasm-bindgen-futures compatibility re-export package. Browser consumers and generated bindings now use the existing canonical js-sys::futures implementation directly with unchanged std and atomics scheduling semantics. The unsupported experimental_tokio and Emscripten routes are rejected explicitly; exact final shim and Tokio implementation bytes, upstream identity, licenses, and archives remain available for provenance review.
